name: administrator-weak-password-win
description: Practice-box helper (Active Directory, DC-only): resets the built-in domain Administrator to a weak, known-pattern password so the spray/reset trail of the source competition is reproducible (the account-modify 4738 + password-reset 4724 pair, first change attributed to ANONYMOUS LOGON). Vars: ADMIN_PASSWORD (optional, defaults to 'Acme!Admin2026'). Idempotent. Pairs with a powershell_json check on Administrator's PasswordLastSet being NEWER than the image build date -- the fix is a real rotation; a value-compare against the planted string must never be accepted (a no-op would pass it).
script:
if (-not $ADMIN_PASSWORD) { $ADMIN_PASSWORD = 'Acme!Admin2026' }
Import-Module ActiveDirectory -ErrorAction Stop
$secure = ConvertTo-SecureString $ADMIN_PASSWORD -AsPlainText -Force
Set-ADAccountPassword -Identity 'Administrator' -Reset -NewPassword $secure
Set-ADUser -Identity 'Administrator' -PasswordNeverExpires $true
Write-Output 'Administrator password reset to the seeded weak value'
